user.title: Withings developer app
user.description: Create an application at https://developer.withings.com (Public API integration) and enter its credentials. The callback URL must exactly match one registered on the Withings app. It does not need to be reachable: you only copy the code from the address bar after authorizing.

withings_authorize.title: Authorize Withings
withings_authorize.description:
1. Open [this Withings authorization link]({auth_url}) and grant access.
2. You will be redirected to `{callback_url}?code=...&state=...` (the page itself may fail to load, that is fine).
3. Paste the full address from the browser, or just the `code` value, below.

**The code expires about 30 seconds after it is issued**, so paste it promptly. If it has expired, open the link again.

garmin.title: Garmin Connect
garmin.description: Enter your Garmin Connect credentials. The password is only used to log in once and is not stored.

garmin_mfa.title: Garmin verification code
garmin_mfa.description: Enter the verification code Garmin sent for {email}.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The Withings or Garmin session has expired or been revoked. Continue to authorize both accounts again.

error.no_code: No authorization code found in what you pasted.
error.state_mismatch: The pasted URL belongs to a different authorization attempt. Use the link shown on this page.
error.invalid_code: Withings rejected the code. It may have expired (codes are valid for about 30 seconds). Open the link again.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the service.
error.invalid_mfa: The verification code was rejected. Log in again to receive a new code.
error.rate_limited: Garmin is rate limiting logins. Wait a while and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Withings account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: You authorized a different Withings account than the one configured.

sync.name: Sync now
sync.description: Sync new measurements from Withings to Garmin Connect.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Only sync this entry. Defaults to all configured entries.

features.name: Features
features.description: Data to sync. Defaults to the features selected in the integration options.
